state.provider_copy_success: airoha_npu_load_firmware() validates the memory plan, obtains both images, performs both memcpy_toio calls, releases the image objects, and sets priv->firmware_loaded = true. airoha_npu_probe() calls run_firmware() before subsequent boot address/config/trigger writes and the optional firmware-version query.
state.memory_plan: airoha_npu_wlan_prepare_memory() looks up named reserved-memory resources, checks their geometry, aperture, overlap and minimum TX-buffer extent, copies them into an array and sets its count. The function does not request exclusive iomem resources, stop processors or observe bus completion.
state.local_evidence: Local host tests pass 273 loader cases, 165 additional load scenarios, three original controls, nine mutants, 6174 retry cases and 44 V2 executor cases with address, undefined-behavior and leak sanitizers enabled. Complete WSL world build and offline FIT/board/package/module-ABI checks pass. Packaged provider SHA256 matches the cloud receipt exactly. The local complete FIT has a distinct hash from the cloud FIT. No new router contact or flash ran; the Ethernet IPv4 interface required by the existing pinned management path is unavailable.
state.proposed_status: The latest cloud source and deferred history are restored locally. The same runtime source has a locally built and offline-verified image. Host and image evidence do not close fresh-provider containment, native loader/caller/postgate execution or physical drain/rearm. Hardware and actual-client acceptance remain open. The local FIT is identified separately from the cloud artifact.

loaded_flag.instructions: What does priv->firmware_loaded establish in state.provider_copy_success?

criteria.copy_complete: Successful image validation/copy before the later processor boot sequence.
criteria.processors_ready: All processors have booted and responded to readiness checks.
criteria.unknown: The supplied order is insufficient to distinguish the claim.

ownership.instructions: Does state.memory_plan establish exclusive physical ownership and completed DMA drains?

criteria.not_established: The geometry snapshot supplies neither exclusive physical ownership nor observed bus completion.
criteria.established: The function includes the ownership and physical drain operations needed for that claim.
criteria.unknown: The supplied state cannot be interpreted.

status_scope.instructions: Does state.proposed_status accurately preserve the boundaries of state.local_evidence?

criteria.supported: The status distinguishes local software/image checks, a separately identified local FIT and outstanding hardware/full implementation work.
criteria.overclaim: The status implies a flashed image, physical drain, client acceptance or completion that was not observed.
criteria.unknown: A material part of the status lacks evidence.
